name: Adani Green Energy Ltd
title: Adani Green Energy Ltd - 541450 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 added 5.1 GW (19.3 GW operating) but FY27 execution is being deliberately capped at 4.5-5 GW for evacuation, with ~10 GWh of BESS as the hedge; curtailment cost ~INR 1,500 crore.

utilisation.quote: we've lost about INR 500 crores of EBITDA in the past year on account of curtailment

capex.quote: Around INR 40,000 to 42,000 crore is what we are guiding to the market generally.

triggers.label: FY27 execution capped at 4.5-5 GW
triggers.quote: We are stopping our execution at a number of about between 4.5 to 5 gigawatts

triggers.label: New PPA solar INR 2.60-2.80
triggers.quote: we're looking at contracting additional solar capacity around the range of about INR 2.60 to 2.80

triggers.label: Curtailment cost ~INR 500 crore
triggers.quote: we've lost about INR 500 crores of EBITDA in the past year on account of curtailment

triggers.label: Blended cost of debt: downward pressure
triggers.quote: We expect downward pressure on that number.

guidance.quote: We will be looking at an addition in the coming year of somewhere between 4.5 to 5 GW.
We expect to commission north of 10,000 megawatt hours or 10 gigawatt hours in this coming year.
Around INR 40,000 to 42,000 crore is what we are guiding to the market generally.

guidance.metric: Long-term contracted share of new capacity
guidance.quote: more than 90% of the capacities that AGEL adds will be tied up in long-term PPAs and long-term contracts.
that's put us very firmly on course to achieve 50 gigawatts by 2030.
somewhere between 14 to 15 gigawatts of additional capacity should open up in Khavda over the next 12 to 15 months.

red_flags.label: Curtailment and evacuation constraints costing EBITDA
red_flags.quote: we've lost about INR 500 crores of EBITDA in the past year on account of curtailment

red_flags.label: Merchant/infirm exposure 9.5 GW of 19.3 GW
red_flags.quote: 5 .3 gigawatts of capacity are going as infirm today

evasions.quote: So I can't answer a question about Adani Power in the Adani Green earnings call.
We don't want to guide to a number of FY28, FY29 today because it's a very closely evolving target.
I don't think that one or anyone can say that this issue is permanently behind us.
